description: We are Team Kilobyte, tackling the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge! Our goal is to build an intelligent, interactive web tool that analyzes terrain, surface hazards, and mission constraints to pinpoint optimal lunar landing sites. We bring strong foundations in full-stack development, ML, and data visualization. We're looking for passionate teammates with skills in 3D/spatial data, planetary science, or storytelling to help make our navigator accurate, sleek, and intuitive!
